In that case, be sure to stay for the WHOLE show!|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on Wave 1 ([[The Haunted Past]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Pumpkid ''' was the first enemy that appeared in the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and an above average speed. ==Appearance== The '''Pumpkid''' was a small brownish-orange humanoid pumpkin. Its limbs and torso were damaged and had multiple dark brown thorns growing out of them. Its torso also had a large hole in it. It had a jack-o'-lantern for a head, with a glowing yellow interior and a happy expression. It made a ghostly gasping sound on death. ==Strategy== *Cheap and high DPS towers like the [[Crook Boss]]/[[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Golden Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] can kill it easily. *Towers with the capability of damaging multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]] or the [[Pyromancer]]/[[Golden Pyromancer]], are extremely useful against this enemy. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} PumpkidWalk.gif|Walking animation (28 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Act 1 Scene 1|'''Pumpkid''' in the opening [[A Dark Tale]] cutscene. }} ==Trivia== *There was a chance where upon triumphing first act in the [[Lunar Overture Event]], you could get a {{RLinkC|15169225890|Pumpkid Shoulder Pal}} accessory, which was based on this enemy. *The '''Pumpkid''' is a portmanteau of "Pumpkin" and "Kid". *The '''Pumpkid''' and the [[Sin]] are some of the smallest enemies in the game. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **'''Pumpkid''' added. *'''31 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]g **'''Pumpkid''' now appears in [[The Haunted Past]]. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Pumpkid''' removed. {{ADarkTale|Start|N/A|Pumpkid|Wave 1|[[Overgrowth (Lunar Overture)|Overgrowth]]|Wave 3}} {{TheHauntedPast|Start|N/A|Pumpkid|Wave 1|[[Skeleton (Lunar Overture)|Skeleton]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
